provenance.existing: Budgets, hard requirements and fit targets are derived from design/balance.json recipes and design/components.json part values. No component, price or demand-cap value is changed here.
provenance.new: Archetype names, weights, reputation deltas, price-acceptance curve and fit rule are original game design candidates awaiting user review.
provenance.limits: A monthly order generation model, not a validated market forecast. It splits the existing company demand caps by archetype rather than replacing them.

mass.depositNote: Standard machines are built to stock, so no customer pays before delivery. The mass route runs on supplier credit instead.

bespoke.depositNote: A commissioned build is ordered in advance, so half the agreed price arrives before any part is bought. This is what lets a workshop start with almost no cash.

archetypes.note: 预算最紧，只要能用；没有静音要求，因此便宜但偏吵的配置也能成交
有噪声上限，主流游戏样机的 50 会被拒，逼玩家换安静散热或机箱
唯一有存储下限的量产客户，120GB 固态刚好达标
必须有独显，核显方案直接出局；不介意噪声
噪声上限 20 排除了噪声 42 的预算办公，玩家必须真正做静音设计
存储下限 1000GB 排除了只有 250GB 的主流游戏机，必须加工作盘

reputation.note: 顾客给店铺打分，与外卖平台的商家评分同一套做法：每交付一台就留下一条评价，店铺的分是这些评价的加权平均。所以它随每一单跳动，而且单子越多越难被少数几条好评拉起来。初始 1 分，因为一条评价都没有。
reputation.priorNote: 开局按 3 条 1 分评价计入，等价于「没有记录就不该有好名声」。它决定新店要多少单才能把分数拉上来。
reputation.reviewsNote: 达标时 3 分保底、有机会拿到 4 与 5；超额完成时 5 分的比例大幅上升；迟交与让客户失望则落在 1—3 分。每一条评价都是随机的，所以店铺的分会自然跳动。

priceAcceptance.formula: ratio = price / reference; below reference: clamp(1 + belowSlope*(1-ratio), 1, ceiling); above reference: clamp(1 - aboveSlope*(ratio-1), floor, 1)
priceAcceptance.marketReferencePrice: midpoint of the archetype budget range
priceAcceptance.budgetCeiling: A price above the archetype budget maximum never sells, whatever the acceptance value.
priceAcceptance.note: 斜率按细分市场标定：量产客群极度价格敏感（现实里大厂毛利被压到 13%），高定客群对价格不敏感。斜率取值保证有效贡献在接近市场参考价处最高，加价不能无脑赚钱 接受度还会乘以外观偏好系数，见 appearancePreference

fit.note: 用途适配 F 只看得分；硬性要求不满足时订单直接不成交，不由 F 补偿

monthlyVolume.splitRule: Each segment's monthly cap is split across its archetypes in proportion to weight.

appearancePreference.note: 外观分高于基准时客户愿意为这台机器多付钱，满分外最多 +15%；客户想要的数量不变，所以这条只作用于价格，不影响需求上限
